feeds.title: Sax School Online Blog
feeds.description: Sax School is the ultimate online resource for saxophone lessons for all abilities. Learn saxophone at your own pace with our huge library of online saxophone lessons for beginner and intermediate players.

feeds.title: Best. Saxophone. Website. Ever.
feeds.description: Best. Saxophone. Website. Ever. is the web's most frequently updated home for saxophone tips, techniques, interviews, reviews, news and just about anything else for the saxophone player looking to improve their craft and have a great time doing it.

feeds.title: Neffmusic Blog
feeds.description: Steve Neff has been playing and teaching saxophone and jazz improvisation for 30+ years to students all around the world. Dive into their blog and learn more about the latest updates, videos, articles, and more on music.

feeds.title: Cafe Saxophone
feeds.description: Cafe Saxophone is an International saxophone forum for debate, banter, ask questions, answer them or just sit back, relax and have fun. It is an online establishment for saxophone players to meet, have a chat, a debate, listen to and critique each others' playing.

feeds.title: Saxquest Blog
feeds.description: Saxquest is the specialist in saxophone and woodwind instruments, repair and accessories. Keep up with the latest news from Saxquest, famous players as they come through our shop, see the latest instruments as the arrive, mark your calendar for shop clinics and master-class offerings and more. Check out the sax museum, sax trivia contest, repair shop & more.

feeds.title: Sam Newsome's Blogsite
feeds.description: Sam Newsome's Blogsite was created as a platform for Sam Newsome to share his thoughts, music, and to connect with fellow sax players and musicians committed to sharing ideas about the soprano saxophone.

feeds.title: Craig Buhler
feeds.description: Craig Buhler is Director & first tenor sax with Sequim's Stardust Big Band and the Carmel Big Band Workshop. Follow his blog to find more on saxophone.

feeds.title: University of Victoria Saxophone Studio
feeds.description: University of Victoria Saxophone Studio is for UVic alumni and current students, guests from near and far, professionals and amateurs, drop-ins, drop-bys, drive-bys, hangers-on, saxophone enthusiasts. This is a blog for and about saxophonists and their music.

feeds.title: Nathan Hassall
feeds.description: Nathan Hassall is a London based professional saxophone teacher Professor of Saxophone, London College of Music Face-to-Face or Online Lessons Available Always wanted to play the saxophone, but not sure where to start? Want to take your playing to the next level? Nathan Hassall has a wealth of experience in teaching the saxophone to anyone.

feeds.title: Stuff Sax
feeds.description: Stuff sax is about saxophones. This gives gnome-honey a place to post saxophone information based on things that gnome-honey mess around with, experiment with, modify, break, fix, ruin, etc. Follow this blog to find the information on saxophone repair, saxophone refinishing, saxophone mouthpiece refacing, saxophone accessories, saxophone reviews.

feeds.title: Saxophone Technique Blog
feeds.description: Saxophonist Sarah Anne Wolkowski has been playing since she was in the seventh grade. She holds two saxophone performance degrees: a Bachelor of Music from McGill University (High Distinction) and a Master of Music from the University of Alberta. Read her blog to know more about saxophones.

feeds.title: Musings from a Saxophonist Blog
feeds.description: The official blog of saxophonist and composer Ellery Eskelin. Follow his saxophone journey and music compositions in this blog.

feeds.title: JazzBariSax.com
feeds.description: Dedicated to the king of all Instruments | Since 1999.

feeds.title: Better Sax Blog
feeds.description: Better Sax is all about solving this problem that many saxophone players have. At Better Sax, our goal is to make you a better saxophone player by showing you the simplest, most effective process to achieve your goals on the instrument and have a great time along the way.

feeds.title: How To Play Saxophone Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to play saxophone with free simple video lessons. Discover the most important saxophone techniques that will give the solid foundation you need on How To Play Saxophone Blog.

feeds.title: SOPRANOPLANET Blog
feeds.description: There is a lot of information, insights, and thoughts about playing soprano saxophone here. You will find a lot of important information about all things soprano such as intonation on soprano saxophone, about common issues on soprano sax, about players, music and a lot more.

feeds.title: HowToPlayTheSax.com Blog
feeds.description: Covers saxophone lessons, hints, tips, guidance, structure, curation you need to be the saxophone player that you have always wanted to be. HowToPlayTheSax website is dedicated to helping you become a better saxophonist.

feeds.title: Anastasia Mcqueen
feeds.description: International female saxophonist Anastasia Mcqueen has extensive experience in making and organizing events, weddings, corporate events with Flyboard and saxophone in Ibiza and worldwide. Her attention to detail makes her saxophone shows unique and extremely elegant.

feeds.title: The Saxophone Corner
feeds.description: The Saxophone Corner focuses on reviews and discussions about saxophones new and vintage, saxophone players and recordings.

feeds.title: Everything Saxophone
feeds.description: Saxophonist Ben Britton is an active educator and performer in the U.S. His blog Everything Saxophone features various articles on saxophone technique, equipment, and jazz improvisation.

feeds.title: Matt Telfer
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Matt Telfer a London based saxophone player. Find out about my gigs, latest albums and further details on saxophone lessons.

feeds.title: London Saxophone Festival Blog
feeds.description: The London Saxophone Festival 2018 is the first of its kind. A festival experience, in celebration of the saxophone through concerts, activities, workshops. It will incorporate a wide range of workshops and educational events for families, aimed at providing knowledge, insights and inspiration to aspiring musicians or anyone curious to find out more about the saxophone.

feeds.title: Neil Welch Blog
feeds.description: Regardless of the educational medium, Neil aspires to help students of all ages reveal and cultivate their artistic voice within. Saxophonist Neil Welch is a Seattle-based acoustic and electronic artist. His sonic formations are firmly linked to the natural world, drawing artistic guidance from the abundant wildernesses of the Pacific Northwest.
